fields.statement: At 3866a47a ran go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./internal/guide/...: all 20 tests PASS, including TestWorkflowsText, whose new dispatch group requires .rhiza/dispatch.toml, [request], [ready], rhiza request --workflow, feature/bug/milestone, ship-change and workflow-unresolved in the workflows topic, and the existing size checks TestCaps, TestCapCatchesOversize and TestTokens. Read the diff: the new Dispatch section of internal/guide/text/workflows.md matches internal/dispatch (two tables, three kinds, an error naming any other table, key or value, defaults plan and ship-change, no kind means feature) and readyPick/startWorkflow in internal/api/run.go (explicit --workflow, then the request's workflow, then the [ready] rule, then ship-change). It also covers the workflow-unresolved skip with no fallback. Minor: a stray comma in 'the request opens,.' for the review run to fix.
